arxiv-2301-00318.title: Effect of Edge Roughness on resistance and switching voltage of Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
arxiv-2301-00318.creator: Rachit R. Pandey, Sutapa Dutta, Heston A. Mendonca, Ashwin A. Tulapurkar
arxiv-2301-00318.description: Abstract We investigate the impact of edge roughness on the electrical transport properties of magnetic tunnel junctions using non-equilibrium Green’s function formalism. We have modeled edge roughness as a stochastic variation in the cross-sectional profile of magnetic tunnel junction characterized by the stretched exponential decay of the correlation function.

arxiv-2311-07961.title: The ART of LLM Refinement: Ask, Refine, and Trust
arxiv-2311-07961.creator: Kumar Shridhar, Koustuv Sinha, Andrew Cohen, Tianlu Wang, Ping Yu, Ram Pasunuru Mrinmaya Sachan Jason Weston Asli Celikyilmaz
arxiv-2311-07961.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable generative abilities, but can they judge the quality of their own generations? A popular concept, referred to as self-refinement , postulates that LLMs can detect and correct the errors in their generations when asked to do so.

arxiv-2412-13090.title: Exploring the Dark Age: Star and Galaxy formation in the Early Universe
arxiv-2412-13090.creator: K. El Bourakadi, G. Otalora
arxiv-2412-13090.description: Abstract The Cosmic Dark Ages mark a pivotal era of the universe’s evolution, transitioning from a neutral, opaque medium to the emergence of the first stars and galaxies that initiated cosmic reionization. This study examines the thermodynamics of the intergalactic medium (IGM), molecular hydrogen cooling, and gravitational collapse that led to structure formation.

arxiv-2505-14300.title: Beyond Black-Box Obfuscation: Mechanistic Analysis and Defense of White-Box Monitors
arxiv-2505-14300.creator: Maheep Chaudhary, Fazl Barez
arxiv-2505-14300.description: Abstract White-box monitoring is increasingly adopted as an auditing tool as Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed in daily operations to ensure safe model behavior. However, white-box monitors can be circumvented, and the mechanisms underlying such evasion have not been systematically characterized, nor have principled defenses been proposed. This work addresses both challenges.

arxiv-2507-18760.title: Overview of recent results from the STAR experiment
arxiv-2507-18760.creator: \firstname Isaac \lastname Mooney \fnsep for the STAR Collaboration
arxiv-2507-18760.description: Abstract We highlight the STAR experiment’s recent measurements on electromagnetic and hard probes of nuclear collisions, which inform the field’s understanding of these physical phenomena and by extension QCD. Results on vector meson production from the high electromagnetic fields in glancing heavy-ion collisions are presented.

arxiv-2602-21982.title: On combinatorial bounds for the total Tjurina numbers of certain curves and surfaces with isolated singularities
arxiv-2602-21982.creator: Piotr Pokora
arxiv-2602-21982.description: Abstract We investigate combinatorial bounds for the total Tjurina numbers of plane curve arrangements. Focusing on arrangements of lines and conics in ℙ 2 \mathbb{P}^{2} that admit only ordinary quasi-homogeneous singularities, we derive new structural inequalities governing the distribution of multiple intersection points.

pmc-10604057.title: Machine Learning-Based Measurement of Regional and Global Spinal Parameters Using the Concept of Incidence Angle of Inflection Points
pmc-10604057.creator: Thong Phi Nguyen, Ji-Hwan Kim, Seong-Ha Kim, Jonghun Yoon, Sung-Hoon Choi, Yunfeng Wu
pmc-10604057.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This study delves into the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in evaluating spinal sagittal alignment, introducing the innovative concept of incidence angles of inflection points (IAIPs) as intuitive parameters to capture the interplay between pelvic and spinal alignment. Pioneering the fusion of IAIPs with machine learning for sagittal alignment analysis, this research scrutinized whole-spine lateral radiographs from hundreds of patients who visited a single institution, utilizing high-quality images for parameter assessments.

pmc-10619190.title: Clinical Analysis and Applications of mRNA Vaccines in Infectious Diseases and Cancer Treatment
pmc-10619190.creator: Paa Kwesi Ankrah, Ajibola Ilesanmi, Amos O Akinyemi, Victor Lasehinde, Oluwapelumi E Adurosakin, Oluwatobi H Ajayi
pmc-10619190.description: Vaccination, for centuries, has been a potent preventive technique to treat morbidities. The messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccine technology is an innovative biomedical approach utilized in developing antigen-specific vaccines that can generate adaptive immune responses, triggering both humoral and cellular immunity to enhance the body's defense against specific infections.

pmc-11300536.title: Yellowness in skin complexion: Analysis of self‐perception of women in China evaluated against clinical parameters of yellowness
pmc-11300536.creator: Bee Leng Lua, Julie Robic
pmc-11300536.description: BackgroundSkin “yellowness” is an abstract and subjective term, without a definitive measurement protocol. Objectives were to analyze Chinese women's self‐perception of skin yellowness and associated parameters and identify objective clinical measurements that correlate with these perceptions.MethodsFollowing focus group discussions, criteria for skin yellowness were defined, and validated by volunteer rankings of facial images.

pmc-11683062.title: Immunoproteasome inhibition reduces donor specific antibody production and cardiac allograft vasculopathy in a mouse heart transplantation model
pmc-11683062.creator: Allison M. Schwalb, Imran Anwar, Isabel DeLaura, Joseph M. Ladowski, Janghoon Yoon, Rafaela Belloni, Mingqing Song, Carolyn Glass, Jun Wang, Stuart Knechtle, Jean Kwun
pmc-11683062.description: ObjectiveCardiac Allograft Vasculopathy (CAV), a process of vascular damage accelerated by antibody-mediated rejection (AMR), is one of the leading causes of cardiac transplant failure. Proteasome inhibitors (PIs) are utilized to treat AMR, however PI-associated toxicity limits their therapeutic utility. Novel immunoproteasome inhibitors (IPIs) have higher specificity for immune cells and have not been investigated for AMR in cardiac transplant patients.

However, Whole-Genome Sequencing is associated with a statistical challenge known as the p >> n problem. We classified 1825 individuals into five breeds based on 11,915,233 SNPs.

pmc-12586746.description: ObjectiveThe World Health Organization identifies colorectal cancer as the third-most diagnosed malignancy and second leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Up to 30% of patients relapse within 5 years postoperatively; however, conventional staging methods cannot reliably stratify individual risks, underscoring the need for precise, patient-centred decision-support tools.

pmc-12846712.title: The Bacterial Swiss Army Knife: ExPEC Utilizes Multiple Resistance Mechanisms to Counteract Host Immune Responses
pmc-12846712.creator: Eveline Weerdenburg, Susan King, Joyce Lübbers, Elise Hovingh, Todd Davies, Jeroen Geurtsen, Germie van den Dobbelsteen, Jan Poolman
pmc-12846712.description: Extraintestinal pathogenic Escherichia coli (ExPEC) is a major cause of infections of the urinary tract, the bloodstream, and other non-intestinal sites in humans. ExPEC often resists the bactericidal action of human immune defenses including complement, antimicrobial peptides, antibodies, and cell-mediated killing.

pmc-13198326.title: Preparing for the long road: Insights from the first few steps!
pmc-13198326.creator: Naima Maqsood
pmc-13198326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Before delving into the occupational risks, let us remember why we chose this career in the first place. For me, EP is a unique field of medicine with the perfect blend of clinical prowess and procedural satisfaction. We all relate to the joy of ablating a supraventricular tachycardia that plagued a patient’s daily life, or “curing” patients from heart block with a pacemaker.

pmc-13282913.title: Formic Acid Stabilization on Supported Ionic Liquid Phases: Insights from Solid‐State NMR Spectroscopy
pmc-13282913.creator: Yufei Wu, Yuyan Zhang, Walter Leitner, Alexis Bordet, Thomas Wiegand
pmc-13282913.description: Ionic liquids (ILs) are known to promote the catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 to formic acid, in particular by shifting the reaction equilibrium through formic acid stabilization. While a broad range of ILs‐formic acid interactions has been described, proposed, and discussed in pure IL systems, the molecular basis for such stabilizing effects is not yet fully understood.

pmc-13346943.title: Trends and patterns of antimicrobial resistance among Staphylococcus aureus isolated from various clinical specimens: a national laboratory-based AMR surveillance, 2020–2024
pmc-13346943.creator: Zeleke Ayenew, Meseret Aseffa Oda, Semira Ebrahim Geleto, Tewodros Minwuyelet Anteneh, Etsehiwot Adamu Tsegaye, Yonas Mekonnen Gebeyehu, Dejenie Shiferaw Teklu, Degefu Beyene Gobena, Amete Mihret Teshale, Gebrie Alebachew Belete, Surafel Fentaw Dinku, Tesfa Addis Kefale, Elias Seyoum Derebe, Abera A
pmc-13346943.description: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) is a global public health concern responsible for a wide range of infections. In Ethiopia, patterns and trends of MRSA in various clinical specimens are limited. Therefore, this study aimed to determine the trend and pattern of S. aureus isolated from 16 AMR surveillance sentinel sites.

pmc-13393347.title: Genital leech infestation presenting with vaginal bleeding in a 55-year-old Ethiopian woman: Case report and literature review
pmc-13393347.creator: Ahmed Siraj Mohammed, Kelil Hussein Jibicho, Kedir Negesso Tukeni
pmc-13393347.description: BackgroundGenital leech infestations, primarily occurring in tropical and subtropical areas with untreated water, present clinical challenges due to their hematophagous nature and the chemicals they emit for attachment and bleeding. This report details a case of vaginal leech infestation, noting its rarity and the complications it poses, particularly with symptoms such as vaginal hemorrhage.
